title: Bring your people: weekly reminder
summary: A prompt above Conversas, at most once a week, that names one person from bring-people who has not joined yet and offers to send the invite again, or a new one when it expired.

kind.description: pending: the invite still works, body bipe_bring_people_reminder_pending, action bipe_bring_people_resend. expired: body bipe_bring_people_reminder_expired, action bipe_bring_people_expired_action.

inviteId.description: The invite of the named slot.

act.effect: pending: opens the system share sheet with the same link (invites, where the row opens invite-qr, when the link is on another phone). expired: makes a new invite with the same name, as bring-people replaceExpired.

notNow.effect: Hides the prompt and adds one decline. After bringPeople.stopAfterDeclines declines (2), across the first sheet and the reminders, no bring-people ask shows again on this account.

notes: Trigger bringPeopleDue: Conversas is on screen; at least bringPeople.followUpEveryDays (7) days since the last bring-people ask on this account; fewer than 2 declines; and a slot is sent for at least bringPeople.pendingAfterDays (3) days, or expired. Pick the oldest such slot. No slot qualifies: no reminder.
Every reminder names one person. No generic "invite someone" reminder.
Slot prompt: shares the 24-hour slot with the handle, photo and PIN prompts (registries/onboarding.json promptSlot). A slot that joined or is filled again leaves the reminder pool.
The reminder stops for good when every slot joined, or after the second decline.

Place and look (MZ, 31 Oct 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#894): this shows as the entry bringPeopleReminder of chat-list-prompt, one card at a time in the first list row. chat-list-prompt decides when it shows against the other entries; this spec keeps the condition and the come-back time.
